risk_note: RV2 (settlement clawback / rebate / rights reason codes, orders rights sync). FU-CLAWBACK-REASON-CHECK (orchestrator D10-1126 ①, 07:41 correction, D10-1133 ④, D10-1169, D10-1172; 08 BR-TEXT-05 write-back batch 3 in SPEC_REF 03383a1). Only orders.reason / reason_sub (and the reason of the order.clawed_back event) change; amounts, clawback vouchers (sub_type, uniq_key), state transitions and restore eligibility are unchanged, and the clawback cause of a Taobao rights record stays RIGHTS (REFUND_AFTER_SETTLE is not borrowed, so a partial rights clawback never becomes full). Taobao rights (orders/jobs/rights-sync.ts passes the adapter's earning_at through RightsSyncExtras / RightsRecordInput; settlement/rebate/domain/rights-reason.ts decides): earning_time set → REFUND / AFTER_SETTLE; earning_time and received_at both empty → REFUND with no reason_sub (the Taobao order feed has no receipt time, D10-1172); received_at set → REFUND / IN_SALE when the rights record precedes it, else RIGHTS / AFTER_SALE; records without union timing (imports) stay RIGHTS. Refund to zero remaining quantity via PARTIAL_REFUND → R8: REFUND, no reason_sub (a partial refund whose commission drops to 0 stays COMMISSION_ZERO). A waiting rights record answered by a settlement of 0 (settleDiff → R8): Taobao REFUND / AFTER_SETTLE, other platforms RIGHTS, sub_type FULL. A reason_sub chosen by hand is kept (reasonSubWithReason guard). Frozen test test/spec/settlement/refund-r9-baseline/writers.int.test.ts: only line 37 of [AC-B2-04zzf#8a] changes, reason COMMISSION_ZERO → REFUND (D10-327 / D10-1169; red on the old code); #8b / #8c unchanged and declared red_exempt. Host checks: root tsc -b 0, eslint 0, settlement / orders unit 88 files 531 tests, integration 9 groups 289 files 2303 tests; container green check (one worker) 8 rule tests all green. Full verification by the required CI checks.

reviews.note: Codex money review (effort medium; brief listed the citable diff lines, D10-1121 / D10-1125). Round 1 fail, one S1: the Taobao order adapter always gives received_at = null, so 'received_at empty → before receipt' recorded after-receipt rights as REFUND / IN_SALE — ruled D10-1172 (no receipt time → REFUND, no reason_sub), rule test attempt 3 and implementation adjusted. Round 2 fail, one S1: SPEC_REF deaba4f still read IN_SALE for that case; closed by SPEC_REF 03383a1 (batch 3, #3054) and a rebase, code unchanged. Round 3 (incremental) pass, no findings; amounts, vouchers and transitions checked unchanged. Money canary ran (record only).

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests in test/spec/settlement/clawback-reason by a fresh independent Claude (claude-opus-5-5 via claude-run.sh, tester claude-independent), three attempts: 1 new tests; 2 the frozen [AC-B2-04zzf#8a] line 37 COMMISSION_ZERO → REFUND (D10-327 / D10-1169) and the whole refund writes no reason_sub; 3 [AC-B2-04zzs#2] first case REFUND with reason_sub null (D10-1172). Red runs red/1–red/3 red for the right reason, #8b / #8c exempt. spec-test r1 (fresh independent Claude): pass, confirmed the frozen file changes exactly one line inside #8a, red on the old code, and both red_exempt entries byte-for-byte unchanged; one S2 (a hand-chosen reason_sub must not be overwritten) carried into the implementation. r2 incremental: pass, confirmed only the two lines of attempt 3 changed; S2: the #2 title and file header still mention IN_SALE (test attempts at 3 of 3, left as is).
